input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?p ?label ?ts WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label "Perimeter_top_ZN_4" .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?p .
  ?p rdfs:label ?label .
  ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?room ?p ?label ?ts WHERE {
  ?room a brick:Room .
  ?room rdfs:label ?rl .
  FILTER (contains(?rl, "top_ZN_4"))
  ?room brick:hasPoint ?p .
  ?p rdfs:label ?label .
  OPTIONAL { ?p ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts }
  FILTER (contains(?label, "ccupanc"))
}
